name: work-ticket
title: Lab work ticket
for_each: SELECT id,code FROM orders ORDER BY code

sections.title: Bench tasks
sections.sql: SELECT label,technician,due_on,done_on,evidence FROM tasks WHERE order_id=$1 ORDER BY due_on,id

sections.title: Prescription reference
sections.sql: SELECT c.prescription_ref FROM cases c JOIN orders o ON o.case_id=c.id WHERE o.id=$1
sections.note: Use the original authorised prescription. This ticket does not prescribe or design a device.

name: material-record
title: Material trace record
for_each: SELECT id,code FROM orders ORDER BY code

sections.title: Material lots
sections.sql: SELECT t.* FROM traceability t JOIN orders o ON o.code=t.order_code WHERE o.id=$1

sections.title: Quality evidence
sections.sql: SELECT passed,evidence,actor,reviewed_on FROM qc_reviews WHERE order_id=$1 ORDER BY created_at,id

name: delivery-note
title: Delivery note working copy
for_each: SELECT id,code FROM orders WHERE stage='dispatched' ORDER BY code

sections.title: Recorded dispatch
sections.note: Working record from the recorded dispatch. Check recipient and shipment evidence before sharing. Not a statutory device statement.

name: remake-report
title: Remake review
for_each: SELECT id,code FROM orders WHERE remake_of IS NOT NULL ORDER BY code

sections.title: Remake record
sections.sql: SELECT o.code,p.code AS original,o.product,o.remake_reason,o.stage,o.due_on FROM orders o JOIN orders p ON p.id=o.remake_of WHERE o.id=$1
